metadata.purpose: Curated recommendation-relevant observations from installed-client snapshots and explicitly reviewed cross-site evidence that are not all screenshot-audited live facts.
metadata.policy: Installed presence proves implementation in the captured build, not release, activation, availability, or final balance. Unchanged logical resources remain continuing installed evidence. Screenshot-audited data remains higher authority for current player-facing mechanics. Matching Dragonfire Hub and Dragonfire Sim claims may be marked cross-site verified only where the 2026-10-12 audit found no contradiction with supplied client evidence.

evidence_states.screenshot_audited: Exact current in-game wording captured in repository screenshots; primary for recommendations.
evidence_states.cross_site_verified: Matching Dragonfire Hub and Dragonfire Sim data accepted as verified under the user's 2026-10-12 direction, while retaining source disclosure and yielding to contradictory client evidence.
evidence_states.user_confirmed: Current player confirmation supplied directly to this repository; authoritative for the confirmed fact but not for unsupplied mechanics or values.
evidence_states.installed_observed: Present in a dated installed build; usable with an explicit installed-client qualifier.
evidence_states.installed_unverified: Production-shaped installed content whose release or player availability has not been established.
evidence_states.staged: Installed content that must not affect live recommendations without activation evidence.
evidence_states.derived: Strategic or structural interpretation, never a substitute for source wording.

observations.claim: The 2026-11-07 downloaded client resources change Mirage condition references and several combat effect rows, and add Turncloak encounter wording. These schema-less changes do not establish live combat behavior or player-facing balance values; retain screenshot-audited mechanics and do not infer recommendation changes from the changed rows.

The installed client contains 38 production-named dragon rows: 38 screenshot-audited rows. Starshower's and Vermithor's installed rows are retained as corroborating progression evidence, while current screenshots are primary for their mechanics. WIP, test, NPC, wild, balance-test, and unresolved rows are excluded from the canonical application index.
Meleys and Smoketail are user-confirmed available Season 3 dragons. The 2026-10-12 cross-site audit supplied their prior canonical records. Both were subsequently screenshot audited on 2026-11-05.
observations.source: Current user confirmation supplied on 2026-10-01; data/dragons/meleys.json; data/dragons/smoketail.json; wiki/Community-Source-Audit-2026-10-12.md

observations.claim: Meleys has installed Relentless and Physical DPS labels. Her screenshot-audited record caps Laceration at 8 stacks and defines Queen's Vengeance as a chance each round to grant Reflect (100%) versus Basic Attacks for one round, with one Reflect (Damage) effect per target.
Smoketail is a user-confirmed available Epic Hunter with a screenshot-audited Command, Vanguard, and five Habits. Ember Snare explicitly names its ongoing Fire damage effect Burn.

The installed client adds Commander trait affinities and complete or revised talent kits, but current live activation and player availability are not established. Commander traits and talents must not affect formation recommendations yet.

Installed targeter and condition rows distinguish left flank, right flank, Vanguard, Dominant/Stalwart composition, and several Control statuses. Because the extraction is schema-less, use these rows to corroborate explicit ability wording, not to invent targeting or condition semantics.
